source: A production Shockadin request (Holy/Retribution, Manual Crowd Pummeler opener, sim 3da15ee0) with Brutality Blade in its Swap1 set, the character renamed, and the live Shockadin board's talents (05025210221021--0523330110130033, no One-Handed Weapon Specialization) since hotfix push 113554 refuses the original string.
note: Rust prepares it under Rules::Forever; the test compares the seal's hits after the swap with the same character wearing Brutality Blade from the pull.

cases.description: Manual Crowd Pummeler at the pull, swapped for Brutality Blade once its haste fades: Seal of Righteousness's hit takes the one-hander's hand multiplier, speed and spell power share (0.10 a point at rank 8, against the two-hander's 0.12).
